$comment: Single source of truth for Reconclave brand identity. Edit THIS file, then run `python3 tools/generate_identity.py` to regenerate identity.h and identity.css. Do not edit the generated files by hand.

brand.name: Reconclave
brand.tagline: Plan on the desktop. Observe in the field. Keep the evidence together.
brand.meaning: Reconnaissance + Conclave: independent nodes pooling capabilities and evidence.
brand.mascot_role: A project-independent mascot used by Reconclave. Zeta is not the product name or a Reconclave sub-brand.
brand.creator_name_role: Creator credit and account name only; never present it as a product, theme, device, or feature name.

$palette_comment: Canonical palette = the K230/Cardputer 'product family' set (also the README badges). The T-Display K230 ui_shell.h and Cardputer theme are the reference; the T-Dongle-S3 web UI predates this file and must migrate onto these values. Each token: hex plus a stated role. RGB565 (uint16) and 0xRRGGBB (uint32) forms are generated for embedded use.

canvas.role: Deepest application background and display canvas.

accent.role: Primary accent / cyan. Interactive, focus, brand.

danger.role: Failure, destructive action, or blocked unsafe state.

surface_raised.role: Raised surface / cards, headers, selected rows.

surface_selected.role: Selected or focused surface behind foreground content.

border.role: Active component outline, divider, and progress track.

$devices_comment: The fleet roster. `type` is the wire device_type in announce messages. Firmware devices only; the desktop coordinator is listed for completeness but ships no embedded firmware.

devices.role: Permanent hub: plan, dispatch, evidence custody, fleet management.
Portable field console: Wi-Fi/BLE observation, NFC, sub-GHz, GPS.
Wired execution node: network discovery, connectivity checks, automation.
Touch console + edge-perception node: vision, OCR, classification.
USB HID / physical-interface node, scope-gated and evidence-logged.
